title: 第九章  不平静
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“叶落，你以后一定能成为这世界最顶峰的强者，到那时所有的一切，你都将拥有，”

“是吗，月姐，或许到了那个时候我所在意的就不会是这些东西了”，叶落看向沈苍月的双眼；

沈苍月被看得有些不好意思，“你怎么突然这么严肃，我之前可没觉得你是严肃的人”

“哎，或许就是命运吧。”叶落一叹，

沈苍月一惊，“叶落，你怎么突然开始感慨人生了？”转头一看，却发现叶铭嘴角淡淡的笑意，顿时恼了，原来叶落是在取笑她。

“咳咳，月姐，咱们快进去吧，你看都快没位置了。”叶落赶紧逃进了饭店。

沈苍月狠狠地踩了一下地面，“小屁孩！看我等会怎么收拾你！”

远处，几个小混混鬼鬼祟祟地看向沈苍月，“老大，你看，这个女的怎么样，极品啊”一个浑身散发土豪气息的男子旁边，一个像老鼠一样的家伙涎水都留了下来。

“给我注意注意形象，我谢大伟可没有你这么没素质的小弟，不过，你的，大大的好，我会奖励你的，稍后，看本少爷出马，必然，必然，怎么说来着的”

“马到功成”，“嘿嘿”“不错”谢大伟拍了拍黄毛的脑袋，接着直接灵力一震，黄毛脑袋一歪，死了。周围几人吓得魂飞魄散，

“哼，看了本少爷的女人，还要接本少爷的话，真是活腻了。”谢大伟露出一丝残忍的笑。周围几人从黄毛说的第一句话就知道他可能要被打，但属实是没想到直接就杀了，太可怕了，以后还是要少开口啊。

“小李”，谢大伟喊道，那个叫小李的直接被吓得一激灵。

“在，在，在少爷，有什么吩咐？”小李的心颤颤巍巍得，生怕又有什么‘好事’轮到他头上来。

“你怕什么，我刚刚仔细观察了一下，那个女的应该没什么修为，那个男的连灵力威压都没有说明都没有突破炼体境界，你给我把那小子撵走，若是不听话，那就回来告诉我，我亲自去。”谢大伟露出了一丝残忍的笑容。

Page (1/3)

"Ye Luo, you will definitely become the most powerful person in the world in the future. By then, you will have everything."

"Really, Sister Yue, maybe by then I won't care about these things." Ye Luo looked into Shen Cangyue's eyes;

Shen Cangyue looked a little embarrassed, "Why are you so serious all of a sudden? I never thought you were a serious person before."

"Hey, maybe it's fate." Ye Luo sighed,

Shen Cangyue was startled, "Ye Luo, why did you suddenly start to lament life?" She turned around and saw a faint smile on the corner of Ye Ming's mouth, and she was immediately annoyed. It turned out that Ye Luo was making fun of her.

"Ahem, Sister Yue, let's go in quickly. Look, there's almost no room left." Ye Luo hurriedly escaped into the hotel.

Shen Cangyue stomped the ground hard, "Little brat! Let's see how I deal with you later!"

In the distance, a few gangsters looked at Shen Cangyue furtively, "Boss, look, how is this woman? She's top-notch." Next to a man who exuded the aura of a wealthy man, a guy like a mouse drooled.

"Please pay attention to your image. I, Xie Dawei, don't have a young brother with such incompetence as you. However, yours is very good. I will reward you. Later, see if this young master takes action. It will be inevitable. It will be inevitable. How do you say it?"

"It's done right away", "Hey hey" "Not bad" Xie Dawei patted Huang Mao's head, and then his spiritual power was shocked. Huang Mao's head tilted and he died.Several people around were scared to death.

"Hmph, I'm really tired of living after seeing my young master's woman and having to accept my young master's words." Xie Dawei showed a cruel smile.Several people around him knew from the first words Huang Mao said that he might be beaten, but it was true that he didn't expect to kill him directly. It was too terrible. He should speak less in the future.

"Xiao Li", Xie Dawei shouted, and the man named Xiao Li was frightened.

"Here, here, sir, what are your orders?" Xiao Li's heart was trembling, for fear that something good would happen to him again.

"What are you afraid of? I just took a closer look. The woman should have no cultivation. The man didn't even explain the spiritual pressure and has not broken through the realm of body refining. Drive that kid away. If he is disobedient, come back and tell me. I will go in person." Xie Dawei showed a cruel smile.
